name: Count Hasimir Fenring
text: [When a friendly unit deals combat damage to an enemy base:] You may exhaust this leader and defeat a friendly Spice token. If you do, look at that player's hand. You may discard a card from it. If you do, that player draws a card.

backArt.src: Count Hasimir Fenring - The Emperor's Shadow (unit) (art).webp

backText:
[Saboteur]
[When Deployed:] Look at an opponent's hand and discard a card from it.
Once each round, when a friendly unit deals combat damage to an enemy base: You may defeat a friendly Spice token. If you do, look at that player's hand. You may discard a card from it. If you do, that player draws a card.
subtitle: The Emperor's Shadow
